description: Open an uploaded file, or a Figma project’s frame, in an interactive viewer in the chat, for the user: the picture with its open comments as pins they can click to read, resolve or ask you about, a PDF page by page, a video moment by moment, and a switch between its versions. Use it when the user wants to see a file or go through its comments. To look at a file yourself, use get_file: this answer only names the comments. In a client that shows no MCP Apps, nothing opens.

fileId.description: File id from list_files (any version), or target.picture.fileId of a comment

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

name: show_file
title: Show a file to the user
